accounts.label: likely_genuine
accounts.rationale: Very low pass-through ratio and tainted share, with an account age over a year and no shared identifiers with known mules, all point to a genuine business account. The single outflow out of 24 inflows and branch-end classification as absorbed_genuine reinforce this.

results.name: liens only on traced accounts with a matching decision
total liens within the disputed amount
rationales cite only signals in the account's record
no lien on the victim's account

verdicts.reason: The account directly received Rs 129,029.23 from the victim and retained Rs 116,404.27 (tainted share ~8.7% of a Rs 13.39 lakh balance), so the lien targets only the victim's traceable funds and leaves the account holder's own money untouched. Despite the likely_genuine label, the code-computed taint confirms the victim's money is present, and a genuine account can still hold stolen funds…
